LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, ar161400

Manuscript, pen-and-ink and red ink. Depths shown by soundings. Shows Gulf Coast from Mississippi River Delta to Cedar Keys, Florida. Mounted on cloth backing. Printed label describing the map mounted on verso. Order number annotated in pencil in lower margin: 321214/23. Scale ca. 1:1,330,000.
